The arrest followed a complaint filed by a female make-up artist who alleged that **Swarup Biswas** had conspired to prevent her from receiving makeup assignments and extorted money from her through intimidation.  The case is being investigated at New Alipore Police Station, and **Swarup Biswas** will be produced before a lower court in Kolkata on Friday.

recent_articles.title: Draft Supreme Court rules prohibit use of AI for judicial outcomes, witness profiling - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** AI committee has proposed draft regulations to govern the use of artificial intelligence in court processes. The regulations aim to prevent AI from determining judicial outcomes, profiling parties or witnesses, and using “opaque” systems.  They also emphasize human oversight for high-risk applications and require safeguards against widening digital divides. The draft proposes a new apex body at the Supreme Court to oversee AI adoption, policy development, and standard setting. Stakeholders are invited to submit comments before June 20th on the proposed regulations.

recent_articles.title: Indian-Americans behind 96 billion-dollar startups in US, new study challenges rising hate - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A new study by the **National Foundation for American Policy** revealed that **India** leads in providing founders to the US, with 96 billion-dollar startups founded by Indian individuals.  This surpasses other countries like Israel and China, which have significantly fewer immigrant founders of billion-dollar companies. The report highlights the significant role immigrants play in the US startup ecosystem, with nearly 80% of America's unicorn companies having an immigrant founder or a key leadership role. Despite recent social media narratives portraying Indian-Americans as job thieves, commentators praised their entrepreneurial spirit and contributions to the US economy.

recent_articles.title: BJP sends Tarun Chugh to Rajya Sabha, fuels speculation over Bittu’s Punjab role | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** nominated Punjab leader Tarun Chugh to the Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh, fueling speculation about the future political role of Union Minister Ravneet Singh Bittu.  Bittu's name was not included in the first list of candidates for the June 18 Rajya Sabha elections despite his desire to return to active politics in Punjab.  Chugh, a prominent Punjab face in the BJP's national structure, has been nominated amid growing speculation about Bittu's future role.  The development assumes significance as both leaders have expressed their ambitions and political observers view it as a sign of potential plans for them ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: "Can Send Her To Assembly": Expelled Leader's 'Offer' For Mamata Banerjee
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Humayun Kabir**, a former Trinamool Congress leader who formed his own party, Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP), has offered to give **Mamata Banerjee** an assembly seat in Murshidabad if she requests it.  Kabir won two seats in the recent election and now claims he can ensure her victory from Rejinagar by resigning. **Banerjee**, who lost her Bhabanipur seat, must win a by-election to return to the state assembly.

recent_articles.title: UK firm DSP opens GCC in Bengaluru to deliver innovative solutions for global clients - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DSP**, a UK-based enterprise database management company, opened its first overseas Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Bengaluru. The facility, hosted at GoodWorks GCC Nexus in Prestige Tech Park, will scale innovation and deepen expertise for **DSP's** clients globally.  The launch was celebrated by **Paul Cocks**, **Group Chief Operating Officer** of **DSP**, and **K.T. Rajan**, cluster director of Technology, Innovation, Education and Skills at the British Deputy High Commission. **Sanjeev Kumar Gupta**, CEO of the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission, highlighted Bengaluru's position as a global innovation hub with a large pool of talent.

recent_articles.title: Bhupinder Hooda's Remark Fuels Buzz Of Amarinder Singh's Congress Crossover
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Captain Amarinder Singh** is reportedly in contact with **Congress** leaders ahead of the Punjab elections next year, according to former Haryana chief minister **Bhupinder Hooda**.  **Hooda** described **Amarinder** as a senior Congress leader and long-time associate. **Amarinder**, who joined the BJP in 2021 after leaving the Congress, has expressed discomfort with the party's functioning and leadership style, citing a lack of personal outreach from leaders compared to the Congress.  While some senior Punjab Congress leaders have indicated that **Amarinder** would be welcomed back if he chooses to return, the BJP has dismissed the speculation as mere communication without political negotiations.

recent_articles.title: A Lok Sabha Problem Awaits Mamata Banerjee? Humanyun Kabir's Big Claim
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Humayun Kabir**, expelled leader of the Trinamool Congress, claims that 20 MPs within the party are planning to remove **Abhishek Banerjee** as the leader of the party in the Lok Sabha.  Kabir, who heads his own party Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP), stated that these MPs have spoken to the Speaker about this potential removal and that a split within the Trinamool is likely. The current internal conflict within the party stems from disagreements over leadership positions, with some MLAs supporting **Ritabrata Banerjee** instead of **Mamata Banerjee's** chosen candidate for the state assembly leader of opposition position.

recent_articles.title: Plague On Both Your Houses: Bengal Minister On Divided Trinamool
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swapan Dasgupta**, a senior Bengal BJP leader, advised against supporting **Trinamool Congress** rebels, stating that the people's mandate for a "complete detoxification process" should be allowed to unfold. He believes the BJP should not intervene in the internal divisions within the party and instead focus on fulfilling its mandate of providing good governance to West Bengal. Dasgupta criticized both factions of the **Trinamool Congress**, suggesting that neither is deserving of support, as they are plagued by corruption and lack of integrity.

recent_articles.title: How Mamata Banerjee Created Trinamool After Breaking Away From Congress
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee's** Trinamool Congress is experiencing internal dissent, with a faction led by Ritobrata Bandopadhyay challenging the party's organizational structure and power dynamics.  This group criticizes the current leadership, particularly Abhishek Banerjee, and seeks to create a separate political space within Bengal politics. The dissidents are focused on legislative control and ideological legitimacy, raising questions about whether they will demand formal recognition or remain a pressure group. Whether this internal conflict leads to another major split in the party remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: Alpha School’s Ritzy New York City Campus Costs $65,000 a Year—but Isn’t Actually a School | WIRED
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Alpha School**, a company aiming to redefine education through AI, hosted information sessions in Lower Manhattan for wealthy New York City parents. The sessions were led by **MacKenzie Price**, co-founder of the company, and its billionaire principal, **Joe Liemandt**.  The sessions aimed to persuade families to enroll their children at Alpha's new campus, which is a homeschooling center disguised as a private school. The campus costs $65,000 per year.

recent_articles.title: "Ideology With Which Party Was Formed Does Not Exist": Expelled Trinamool MLA Sandipan Saha
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** expelled MLA Sandipan Saha claims that 58 rebel MLAs elected **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of Opposition after signing an attendance register which was later presented as a resolution, alleging forgery.  The rebellion has plunged the party into its gravest internal crisis since its inception, with the rebels securing recognition from the Assembly Speaker and forming their own leadership structure. Saha claims that he and other dissidents were silenced within the party and forced to raise concerns through social media.

recent_articles.title: Woman’s body in a field, self-inflicted gunshot: How Kanpur Police cracked a murder case | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kanpur Police** have identified the body of a 21-year-old woman found in Bulandshahr, ** Uttar Pradesh**, after ten days. The victim had filed a complaint against a private hospital manager, **Devkant Uttam**, alleging sexual assault.  The investigation revealed that **Uttam**, his nephew **Vivek Patel**, and a security guard, **Ajeet Singh**, were arrested for the murder. Police believe **Uttam** strangled the woman after she refused to marry him. The victim's body was identified by her mother based on personal belongings found with the remains.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Rebels Play In Midfield As They Seek Mamata Banerjee's Advice
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ritabrata Bandopadhyay**, a key figure in the dissident camp within the **Trinamool Congress**, stated that they want **Mamata Banerjee** to remain as an advisor to their opposition group. The dissidents are not directly opposing **Banerjee**, but instead criticize the increasing influence of **Abhishek Banerjee**, IPAC-style political management, and the corporatisation of the party. They aim to project themselves as a separate faction within the Trinamool while maintaining respect for **Banerjee**'s leadership. The dissidents argue that they are seeking advice from **Banerjee** and want to eliminate **Abhishek Banerjee** from the opposition leadership.  The group believes this is an internal struggle for the "opposition space" in Bengal politics, which they believe has been neglected by the Trinamool party.
